This '''unnamed plant''' was an abandoned [[droid factory]] located within the [[Factory District]]. [[Feral droid]]s were known to reside there, and had basically torn apart the location. It was the site of a [[Battle in the Factory District|confrontation]] between [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]], the feral droids, and [[Jax Pavan]]'s band of friends.
